entries.Ich sah den Gesandten Allahs ﷺ beim Steh: I saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ raise his hands to shoulder height when he stood for the prayer. He also raised his hands at the takbīr for rukūʿ and when he raised his head from rukūʿ. He did not do that in prostration.
entries.Mālik ibn al-Ḥuwayriṯ hob beim Gebet die: Mālik ibn al-Ḥuwayriṯ raised his hands in the prayer at the takbīr, before rukūʿ, and after he had raised his head from rukūʿ. He reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ did the same.
entries.Die Ehefrau von Ṯābit ibn Qays sagte, si: The wife of Ṯābit ibn Qays said that she found no fault in his religion or his character, but she feared she could not fulfill her marital duties. The Prophet ﷺ asked about returning his garden; she agreed, and he told Ṯābit to accept the garden and pronounce the separation. This shows that a khulʿ with a recognized reason is permissible.
entries.Der Prophet ﷺ warnte ausdrücklich vor de: The Prophet ﷺ expressly warned against the woman who asks her husband for divorce without a recognized serious reason. The warning is not a blanket judgment on every woman who must request a separation. At-Tirmiḏī graded the report ḥasan; the wording given is reported through Ṯawbān.

Assalāmu ʿalaykum.

I help you prepare your Islamic wasiyyah statement step by step.

Important:
- This draft is for preparing your wasiyyah in an ordered and responsible way.
- It does not replace legal advice from the state.
- In special cases I mark points as needing review.
- Islamic answers are given with their sources.

Write „beginnen“ so we can start.

Please give your personal details:

1. Full name
2. Date of birth
3. Place of birth
4. Address/place of residence
5. Place where the wasiyyah is written
entries.Bitte beantworte die Familienfragen:\n\n:
Please answer the family questions:

1. Married?

entries.Gibt es Amānāt/anvertraute Dinge?\n\nGel:
Are there amānāt or items held in trust?

Money, objects, keys, documents, access, or things that must be returned.

If no: Keine bekannten Amānāt.
entries.Welche Vermögenswerte oder wichtigen Dok:
Which assets or important documents should your relatives know about?

Bank accounts, cash, gold/silver/deposits, property, a car, insurance, contracts, important folders, access to papers.
entries.Gibt es offene religiöse Verpflichtungen:
Are there open religious obligations with a financial effect?

Unpaid zakāh, nadhr, kaffārah, or other obligatory payments. If you are unsure, write „unklar“.
entries.Möchtest du eine Wasiyyah bis maximal 1/:
Do you want a wasiyyah of at most one third for a continuing charity or another permitted purpose?

Name the purpose, the share or amount, who carries it out, and whether the recipient is a regular heir.
entries.Bitte bestätige deine Janāzah-Wünsche:\n:
Please confirm your janāzah wishes:

Ghusl according to the Sunnah, kafan, ṣalāt al-janāzah, a Muslim graveyard where possible, refusal of cremation, autopsy only if the law requires it.
entries.Möchtest du festhalten, dass keine relig:
Do you want it recorded that no religious innovations and no unestablished ceremonies are to be held?

No 3rd/7th/40th-day ceremonies, music, wailing, gatherings without proof, structures or domes over the grave, images or statues.
entries.Wer soll Ansprechpartner/Wasiyy/Bevollmä:
Who should be the contact, wasiyy, or authorized person?

Main person, substitute, phone or email optional, tasks: debts, amānāt, janāzah, wasiyyah, family.

Avoid disputes, taqwā, settle the estate fairly, duʿāʾ, and ask people of knowledge.

entries.Am Freitag stehen Ṣalāh auf den Prophete: On Friday, ṣalāh upon the Prophet ﷺ, supplication and the reminder of central themes of the dīn are central.
entries.Für den Freitag ist überliefert, die Ṣal: It is reported for Friday to increase the ṣalāh upon the Prophet ﷺ. No invented fixed number is set for that.
entries.Überliefert ist eine besondere Zeit am F: It is reported that Friday has a special time in which supplication is answered. Among the strong transmitted views is the last time after ʿAṣr until Maghrib.
entries.Der Freitag ist ein besonderer Tag der M: Friday is a special day of the Muslims. This section centers on authentically transmitted guidance about ṣalāh upon the Prophet ﷺ, supplication, dhikr and a short weekly Friday reminder.
entries.Der Freitagsimpuls ist bewusst kurz geha: The Friday reminder is kept short on purpose. The formal Jumuʿah khuṭbah and its fiqh conditions are treated separately.
entries.Allah allein zu dienen ist die Grundlage: Serving Allah alone is the basis of every ʿibādah. Qurʾān 51:56.
entries.Der Mensch wurde erschaffen, um Allah al: The human being was created to serve Allah alone. Tawḥīd is the basis of every ʿibādah and directs heart and action to Allah alone.
entries.Allah hat Jinn und Menschen erschaffen,: Allah created jinn and humans so that they serve Him. The core of this ʿibādah is Tawḥīd: to worship Allah alone and to associate nothing with Him.
entries.Der Prophet ﷺ erklärte Muʿādh ibn Jabal: The Prophet ﷺ explained to Muʿādh ibn Jabal رضي الله عنه that Allah’s right over His servants is that they worship Him alone and associate nothing with Him. That includes supplication, hope, fear, love, trust and every form of ʿibādah.
entries.Tawḥīd ist damit nicht nur ein Wissenska: Tawḥīd is thus not only a chapter of knowledge, but the basis of the whole dīn and the most important preparation for meeting Allah.
entries.Īmān bedeutet Glaube. Der Prophet ﷺ erlä: Īmān means faith. The Prophet ﷺ explained in the ḥadīth of Jibrīl six foundations: faith in Allah, His angels, His books, His messengers, the Last Day and the decree (al-Qadar), the good of it and the bad of it.
entries.Beleg: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Ḥadīṯ Nr. 8 (Jibrīl: Evidence: Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, ḥadīth no. 8 (Jibrīl). In the Qurʾān, al-Baqarah 2:285 names faith in Allah, His angels, His books and His messengers.
entries.Tawḥīd bedeutet, Allah als den Einen anz: Tawḥīd means to acknowledge Allah as the One and to devote worship to Him alone.
entries.Im Qurʾān betont Sūrah al-Ikhlāṣ (112:1–: In the Qurʾān, Sūrah al-Ikhlāṣ (112:1–4) stresses Allah’s oneness. Sūrah an-Naḥl (16:36) names the call to serve Allah and to avoid ṭāghūt.
entries.Tawḥīd ist das Bekenntnis zur Einzigkeit: Tawḥīd is the affirmation of Allah’s oneness. It includes that Allah alone is the Lord and Creator, that worship is due to Him alone, and that His names and attributes are affirmed according to the Qurʾān and authentic Sunnah.
